description:
**Blocked by d06.1 (VText must exist). Read deck §3 "The model:
VNode → LineBuf" and §4 "Component API".**

Two thin single-purpose modules become helper functions returning
`%VText{}`. The modules go away.

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/text.ex` (~36 lines).
  Today: a struct + Component behaviour that splits content on
  newlines and truncates each line to width.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/truncated_text.ex`
  (~45 lines). Same idea, single-line truncation with optional
  ellipsis.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi.ex` —
  `visible_width/1` and `truncate_to_width/3`. The painter calls
  these at VText leaves where width is known.
- All callers — find with:
  `grep -rln "Components.Text\\|Components.TruncatedText" apps/octo_pi_tui/`

**Target shape:**
- New module `OctoPi.TUI.UI` (or fold into `OctoPi.TUI.VDom` —
  pick one and document):
  ```elixir
  def text(string), do: %VText{text: string}
  def text(string, style), do: %VText{text: string, style: style}
  def truncate(string, width), do: ...   # may emit a VText or
                                          # special marker for the
                                          # painter; if marker, add
                                          # a paint case for it
  ```
- Modules `Components.Text` and `Components.TruncatedText` deleted.
- All callers updated to use the helper functions.
- Painter MUST call `WrapAnsi.truncate_to_width/3` when emitting a
  VText whose visible width exceeds the current paint width.

**Acceptance:**
- `Components.Text` and `Components.TruncatedText` modules deleted.
- `grep -rn "Components.Text\\b\\|Components.TruncatedText" apps/octo_pi_tui`
  returns 0 lines outside this commit.
- Existing tests that touched these modules updated to use the
  helper functions; assertions stay green.
- Painter's VText path correctly truncates oversized lines (test
  with a 200-char line at width 80; visible width of result is
  exactly 80).
- Visible-width tracking remains correct in the LineBuf so
  cursor stamping (d06.7) works through truncated lines.
title: Collapse Text + TruncatedText into VText helpers
